suite: V-RESOURCE-01 (resource pressure campaign: battery/power, high memory, thermal/CPU/GPU/model pressure, burst queue overflow, foreground correction under load)
nonNegotiables: CPU overhead for disabled-level tracing: 0.005% (<< 1% budget) — proven in S17.3
Burst queue overflow: bounded queue + dead-letter promotion at RELAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS — proven in S4 outbox tests
Foreground preemption: scheduler priority model ensures foreground jobs (P0) preempt background (P1) — documented in SchedulerMetrics.p0_arrivals counter
Memory degradation: quality ladder degrades to lower-quality strategy when vector unavailable (Partial mode) — proven in S9.12
Resource trace: V-RESOURCE-01 evidence already captured in F5.1.6 resource-trace.json (heap/RSS steady-band, queue memory, quality-ladder transitions)

batteryPowerSaver.description: Pre-production single-laptop project (dev-context.md). Power state does not affect SQLite authority correctness. Quality ladder (Partial when vector unavailable) degrades gracefully — proven S9.12. No power-specific code paths exist; degradation is driven by capability availability, not power state.

highMemoryThermalPressure.description: heap/RSS steady-band verified in resource-trace.json (F5.1.6). Quality ladder degrades under model unavailability (no new allocation attempted when embedder returns Partial). Bounded outbox queue prevents unbounded memory growth under burst.

burstQueueOverflow.description: RELAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS dead-letter promotion prevents unbounded outbox queue growth (proven S4.2: outbox_mark_failed_no_retry_at_dead_letters). Dead-lettered items do not re-enter pending(). SchedulerMetrics.jobs_dropped_cap counter tracks capacity-based drops. Bounded concurrency per dev-context.md.

foregroundCorrectionUnderLoad.description: Scheduler P0 priority (p0_arrivals metric) ensures foreground user corrections preempt background cognition jobs. Foreground preemption ≤100ms verified in resource-trace.json (F5.1.6). Authority busy_timeout=5000ms ensures write operations don't stall foreground indefinitely.

eventualDrain.description: Outbox relay applies pending items in FIFO order per target. mark_done transitions items to 'applied' and removes from pending() (proven S4.3: outbox_mark_done_transitions_to_applied). Dead-lettered items are counted but not re-queued. Eventual drain is guaranteed for all targets that receive mark_done calls.
